text:
You're not ugly. You're unwashed.

It's eleven at night. You're scrolling instead of showering. You justify it. Tomorrow. Later.

Shower every day. Twice in summer heat. Brush twice daily. Annual dental cleaning. Fix crooked or discolored teeth now. Remove ear and nose hair. Trim all back and shoulder hair entirely.

This is the floor. Not the ceiling. Everything you build sits on top of a man who smells clean.

Start today. Shower. Trim the hair. Fix your teeth. Your smell decides everything before you ever open your mouth.
caption:
Hygiene is the discipline that separates successful men from failures in dating. It's the foundation of everything.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
